svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, C++, C#, SQL, Bash. Backend: NestJS, FastAPI, Django, Fastify, Express, Prisma, TypeORM, SQLAlchemy, Zod, Socket.IO, .NET, JWT. Web and mobile: React, Expo, Next.js, Svelte, Vite, Tailwind CSS, three.js, GSAP. Databases: PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Supabase, Redis, PostGIS. DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Traefik, Linux, Prometheus, Semgrep, Railway, Vercel, Netlify. IoT and embedded: ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico, MQTT, Arduino, OpenPLC, CircuitPython, Blender. Data, AI and testing: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, Qiskit, Ollama, Anthropic API, ECharts, Power BI, pytest, Vitest, Jest, Playwright. Workflow: n8n, GoHighLevel, Scrum, Git, GitHub, Jira, Trello, ClickUp.
